description.zh: OTA升级包描述。长度不可超过100个字符。一个中文汉字算一个字符。
description.en: The description of the OTA update package. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character.

description.zh:
OTA升级包ID，OTA升级包的唯一标识符。

OTA升级包ID是调用接口[CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~)创建OTA升级包时，返回的参数之一。

您也可以调用接口[ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~)，从返回参数中查看。
description.en:
The ID of the OTA update package, which serves as its unique identifier.

The OTA update package ID is returned when you call the [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) API to create an OTA update package.

You can also call the [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) API and check the response parameters to obtain this ID.

description.zh: OTA升级包名称，需在阿里云账号下唯一。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角圆括号（()），必须以中文、英文、日文或数字开头，长度限制为1~40个字符。
description.en: The name of the OTA update package, which must be unique within the Alibaba Cloud account. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and half-width parentheses (). It must start with a Chinese character, English letter, Japanese character, or digit, and its length must be 1 to 40 characters.

description.zh: 推送给设备的自定义信息。不限制文本内容格式，长度不超过4096个字符。
description.en: Custom information to push to devices. The content format is unrestricted, but the length cannot exceed 4096 characters.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or **ID** does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.
></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the OTA update package belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 requests per second (QPS) to call this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot modify-ota-firmware --product-key a1uctKe0000 --firmware-id s8SSHiKjpBfrM3BSN0z8030000 --firmware-desc OTA_function_updated --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n8t0000 --firmware-name Firmwaretest --firmware-udi 'ota_notice_:_升级底层摄像头驱动，解决视频图像模糊的问题。' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot ModifyOTAFirmware --region cn-hangzhou --FirmwareDesc OTA_function_updated --IotInstanceId 'iot-0pp1n8t0000' --FirmwareId s8SSHiKjpBfrM3BSN0z8030000 --FirmwareName Firmwaretest --FirmwareUdi 'ota_notice_:_升级底层摄像头驱动，解决视频图像模糊的问题。' --ProductKey a1uctKe0000
